Each run creates nine actual unmerged source pairs with 80 context lines and unequal Mine/Theirs edits, loads three-pane windows, checks exact stage text and 85 aligned rows, original source numbers and ruler arrays, read-only display with LF separators, removed/gap rows and linked scrolling. HEAD/raw index/conflicted working bytes preserved. Owned windows closed; no main app, synthetic/physical input or screenshots.
